subtitles.en: In 1506, the year Motonari's father Hiromoto passed away,

subtitles.speaker: Narrator
subtitles.en: the Chugoku region was ruled by two great powers: the Ouchi in the west and the Amago in the east.

subtitles.speaker: Narrator
subtitles.en: Caught between them, the Mouri clan sided with Ouchi Yoshioki.

subtitles.speaker: Narrator
subtitles.en: Kochiyomaru was granted a character from Yoshioki's name and became Okimoto.

subtitles.speaker: Narrator
subtitles.en: He served in the army of Yoshioki, who marched on Kyoto with Shogun Yoshitane at his head,

subtitles.speaker: Narrator
subtitles.en: and fought in battles across the land.

subtitles.speaker: Narrator
subtitles.en: Meanwhile, to quell any unrest while he was away, Yoshioki

subtitles.speaker: Narrator
subtitles.en: sent Takeda Motoshige home to guard his rear.

subtitles.speaker: Narrator
subtitles.en: But Takeda Motoshige had already been won over by the Amago,

subtitles.speaker: Narrator
subtitles.en: and was biding his time, watching for a chance to expand his lands.

subtitles.speaker: Narrator
subtitles.en: It was then that Okimoto fell ill.

subtitles.speaker: Narrator
subtitles.en: Shojumaru, now of age and renamed Motonari, was twenty years old,

subtitles.speaker: Narrator
subtitles.en: a young man who had yet to see a battlefield.
